title: 第25章 这一役赢的精彩第26章 绝望的他遇见心软的神
slug: 饥荒年我囤货娇养了古代大将军
lines: 上万蛮军手持武器闯入洞口。一开始，他们被秦驽射杀，不敢冒进。
罗葛下令全面攻城。
蛮族为了泄愤，气势汹汹闯入山洞中，发誓要砍死躲在洞里的臭虫老鼠。
他们见山洞里有火光，谨慎放慢脚步。
走近却发现，地上有一大堆木材，正燃烧火焰，周围一个鬼影都没看到。
顿时感觉被戏耍了！
为首蛮族将领气狠了，一脚把燃烧木材踹开，烧红炭火正好落在炸药引线上。
嘭……所有人被炸飞。
战承胤一行人，退离到五公里开外。
陈武还在极力游说战承胤，让他去点燃引线！
忽地，嘭的巨响，无数粉尘冲天而起。
战承胤大喊一声，“卧倒！”
所有人趴下。
地动山摇，巨大爆破声震耳欲聋，山体碎石被炸成粉尘，迸出百米高。
一座大山轰然倒塌在众人面前。
他们第一次看见山体爆破，被这一幕深深的震撼到。
所有不敢置信高耸入云的大山，轰然倒塌在眼前。
爆破弄出的动静太大，不止镇关百姓听见，连攻城的蛮子也听见了。
罗葛是漠北王同父异母的弟弟，他长相黑瘦，头发扎成条条小辫子，留着八字胡须。
他身穿铠甲走出马车，看大军攻城。
当他知道城内有水有粮，恨不得马上把镇关收入囊中。
这次攻城虽未部署，他等不及了。
只要夺下城，占有水和粮食。
漠北王庭一定会支持他上位，成为新漠北王。
不远处，高山传来巨大动静，仿佛苍龙咆哮。
接着是一阵地动山摇，他身形站不稳，差点掉下马车。
他忙问：“发生了什么事？”
有小兵前来报告：
“不好了小王爷，地龙翻身，山洞崩塌了，一万人进去八千，全部埋在里面。”
“剩下的人，由于跑不及时，被山体碎石砸伤，全军覆没！”
罗葛手掐着报信士兵的脖子，面容狰狞，目眦欲裂。
“你说什么，刚开战，就死了一万人？”
报信士兵被他掐到两眼通红，不敢再说话。
content_en:
Tens of thousands of barbarian troops broke into the cave entrance with weapons in hand. At first, they were shot by Qin Fu and did not dare to advance.
Luo Ge ordered a full-scale attack on the city.
In order to vent their anger, the barbarians broke into the cave aggressively and vowed to kill the bed bugs and rats hiding in the cave.
When they saw the light of fire in the cave, they cautiously slowed down.
When I got closer, I found that there was a large pile of wood burning with flames on the ground, and I couldn't see a single ghost around.
I immediately felt like I was being tricked!
The leading barbarian general was so angry that he kicked the burning wood away, and the red charcoal fell right on the fuse of the explosive.
Bang... everyone was blown away.
Zhan Chengyin and his party retreated five kilometers away.
Chen Wu is still trying his best to persuade Zhan Chengyin to light the fuse!
Suddenly, there was a loud bang and countless dust rose into the sky.
Zhan Chengyin shouted, "Lie down!"
Everyone get down.
The earth shook and the mountains shook, the sound of huge explosions was deafening, and the rubble on the mountain was blown into dust and shot out hundreds of meters high.
A huge mountain suddenly collapsed in front of everyone.
They saw the mountain explode for the first time and were deeply shocked by this scene.
All the towering mountains that were unbelievable suddenly collapsed before our eyes.
The noise caused by the explosion was so loud that not only the people in the town heard it, but also the barbarians attacking the city.
Luo Ge is the half-brother of King Mobei. He looks dark and thin, with his hair tied into braids and a mustache.
Wearing armor, he stepped out of the carriage and watched the army attack the city.
When he knew that there was water and food in the city, he could not wait to take the town into his pocket immediately.
Although this siege had not yet been deployed, he could not wait.
Just capture the city and possess water and food.
The Mobei Royal Court will definitely support him to ascend to the throne and become the new Mobei King.
Not far away, there was a huge movement in the mountains, like a roaring dragon.
Then there was a sudden tremor, and he was unsteady and almost fell off the carriage.
He quickly asked: "What happened?"
A soldier came to report:
"Oh no, little prince, the earth dragon turned over and the cave collapsed. Ten thousand people went in and eight thousand were buried inside."
"The remaining people, because they couldn't run in time, were injured by the mountain debris, and the whole army was wiped out!"
Luo Ge held the soldier's neck with his hand, his face was ferocious, and his eyes were about to burst.
"What are you talking about? Ten thousand people died just after the war started?"
The soldier who reported the news was pinched by him until his eyes turned red and he did not dare to speak anymore.
